name: mirage
text: Two bugs, both mine. (1) Stuck arrow: a pull read several things (status, orders, bids, usage, messages, chat) with no time limit, so one slow read kept the arrow up. Each read now gives up after 20 s and the arrow always ends. (2) Still 'Running' after you switched off: the engine only notices the switch within about 10 minutes, and the header ignored your switch and showed its last heartbeat. When your switch is off but the engine is still beating, the header now says 'Stopping: switched off' (yellow), then 'Idle' once it has ended. The numbers under it stay its last reading. Release gate is running now; I'll post the version here when it's out.
